info.title: DeviceKit Public API
info.description: Versioned, scope-gated API over the DeviceKit fleet. Dual auth: the UI uses session tokens (BearerAuth), machines use scoped `dk_` keys (ApiKeyAuth). Write endpoints may additionally require a catalog verb such as `devices:command` or `automations:run` — see `x-required-scope` per operation and `GET /api/v1/scopes` for the catalog.
